title: ReflectMT: Internalizing Reflection for Efficient and High-Quality Machine Translation
abstract: arXiv:2604.19144v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent years have witnessed growing interest in applying Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) to Machine Translation (MT). While most approaches adopt a 'pre-thinking' paradigm and benefit from explicit reasoning trajectories, they suffer from substantial inference cost and latency. To address these limitations, we propose ReflectMT, a two-stage reflection internalization framework for machine translation that employs a 'post-thinking' paradigm. Our approach develops the model's 'translate-reflect-refine' capability through reinforcement learning. In the first stage, we cultivate the model's capacity for high-quality reflection and refinement, thereby enhancing its semantic comprehension and task-specific knowledge. In the second stage, we train the model to internalize the knowledge acquired during reflection. translated_title: ReflectMT：内化反思以实现高效高质量的机器翻译
translated_abstract: 近年来，将大型推理模型（LRM）应用于机器翻译（MT）的研究日益受到关注。虽然大多数方法采用“预先思考”范式并受益于显式的推理轨迹，但它们存在推理成本高昂和延迟较大的问题。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了ReflectMT，一个采用“后置思考”范式的两阶段反思内化机器翻译框架。我们的方法通过强化学习培养模型的“翻译-反思-精炼”能力。在第一阶段，我们培养模型进行高质量反思和精炼的能力，从而增强其语义理解和任务特定知识。在第二阶段，我们训练模型将反思过程中获得的知识进行内化。在WMT24基准测试上，ReflectMT取得了基于GPT-4o的GRF分数86.16，比DeepSeek-R1（84.03）高出2.13分，同时使用约……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: ReflectMT提出一种两阶段反思内化框架，通过强化学习将“翻译-反思-精炼”能力内化到模型中，采用“后置思考”范式在WMT24上以86.16的GRF分数超越DeepSeek-R1，同时大幅降低推理成本和延迟。
en_tdlr: ReflectMT proposes a two-stage reflection internalization framework that uses reinforcement learning to internalize the "translate-reflect-refine" capability, adopting a "post-thinking" paradigm to outperform DeepSeek-R1 on WMT24 with a GRF score of 86.16 while significantly reducing inference cost and latency.
